title: Communication timeout
description: Ground link reports DOWN while telemetry stays fresh. comm_timeout_s is patched to 20 s for a short scenario. At 20 s without contact the link drop is only a warning; at 21 s COMM_TIMEOUT forces SAFE_MODE. The computer must never enter FAULT for a communication problem.
inject: TELEMETRY seq=2 battery_v=7.6 temp_c=22.5 attitude_deg=2.0 comm=DOWN sensors=VALID
TELEMETRY seq=3 battery_v=7.6 temp_c=22.5 attitude_deg=2.0 comm=DOWN sensors=VALID
TELEMETRY seq=4 battery_v=7.6 temp_c=22.5 attitude_deg=2.0 comm=DOWN sensors=VALID
